rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: In Los Angeles, most rental units not under rent control can only be ended for a legal reason listed in the law. If you are evicted for a no-fault reason, like the owner moving in, your landlord may have to pay you relocation money.
rules.requirement_es: En Los Ángeles, la mayoría de las unidades que no están bajo control de renta solo pueden terminarse por una razón legal de la lista de la ley. Si lo desalojan sin culpa suya, por ejemplo porque el dueño se muda, el propietario puede tener que pagarle dinero de reubicación.
rules.coverage_text: Most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles not regulated by the RSO, including single-family dwellings, once the tenant has lived in the unit 6 months or the original lease has expired, whichever comes first. Exceptions include transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some non-profit homeless or substance-abuse facilities, and some HACLA or government-owned properties. Since March 27, 2023, tenants cannot be evicted for nonpayment unless they owe more than the Fair Market Rent for the unit size.
rules.quote: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: California Tenant Protection Act rent cap (AB 1482)
rules.requirement: Under California's AB 1482, yearly rent increases are capped at 5% plus the local cost-of-living change, or 10%, whichever is lower, for covered buildings older than 15 years.
rules.requirement_es: Bajo la ley AB 1482 de California, los aumentos anuales de renta tienen un límite de 5% más el cambio local en el costo de vida, o 10%, lo que sea menor, para edificios cubiertos con más de 15 años.
rules.coverage_text: Buildings older than 15 years (rolling), except deed-restricted affordable units, certain dormitories, owner-occupied two-unit properties, qualifying single-family homes/condos with written notice, and units already subject to the Los Angeles RSO.
